pages.title: Starfire Sword
pages.text: §lWeapon Effects§r$(br)Armor +100$(br)Toughness +25$(br)Damage reduction 25%.$(br2)§lBuilt-in Enchantments§r$(br)Sharpness XII$(br)Smite XII$(br)Looting XII$(br)Knockback II$(br)Dawn I.$(br2)§lEternal Spark§r$(br)Prevents one fatal hit. Cooldown: 300 seconds.$(br2)§lStarfire Mark§r$(br)Hits mark targets and release a blue flame wave. Hitting the marked target again deals 100% more damage.

pages.title: Step 1: Add the Base Sword
pages.text: Place the Sword of the Free Will in the left anvil slot.

pages.title: Step 2: Add the Dawn Star
pages.text: Place 1 Dawn Star in the right anvil slot. The upgrade costs 5 experience levels.

pages.title: Step 3: Upgrade Complete
pages.text: With the Sword of the Free Will on the left and the Dawn Star on the right, the anvil outputs the Eternal Starfire variant. §c§lImportant: all accumulated Dawn levels on the sword are cleared after the upgrade!§r
